_comment: Sorkin Arcade manifest — single source of truth. Add a game = add an entry to `games`. Builder/character cards come from `builders`. Drop image URLs into a builder's `faces` array (e.g. character composites or photos in arcade/faces/) and the marquee reel cross-fades through them; empty = pixel-sprite placeholder. `madeWithClaude: true` adds the subdued Anthropic star.
